title: Freightliner Cascadia FUPS Compliant Custom Built Polished Aluminium Bullbar #14
description: Freightliner Cascadia FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Bullbar, Custom contoured heavy duty main channel with provision for Active Brake Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control. Heavy duty box uprights with combination day light running indicator and park light LED lights in outer uprights. High tensile 6mm wall polished aluminium tube recessed welded into the box uprights, no but welds plus provision for driving lights. Custom built light weight high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow 35mm tow pin.
